concerns.location: tasks.md:T004, T006, T008 vs contracts/result.schema.yaml and contracts/statistical_test_result.schema.yaml
concerns.text: T004/T006 require ks_results.json to conform to statistical_test_result.schema.yaml (requires alpha_threshold, scope; additionalProperties:false), while T008 says power_analysis.json fields are 'per the result schema' — but result.schema.yaml is a mutually exclusive schema for the same KS output requiring nested alpha_sweep_results and power_analysis. An implementer cannot deterministically produce a ks_results.json satisfying both; name ONE canonical schema per output file and fix the T008 reference.

T007's default sweep [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10] contradicts FR-009 (α ∈ {0.05, 0.06}) and the spec edge case ({0.04, 0.05, 0.06}). The 'borderline' flip-detection semantics depend on the sweep set; the implementer has three conflicting sources with no stated precedence. Pick one canonical set (or state explicitly that the config default supersedes FR-009 and record the deviation).

T005 says 'attempt to fetch LVK selection-efficiency/injection data from its public Zenodo release' but names no DOI, record ID, or configured URL, and gives no verification for the fetch attempt itself (e.g., a logged HTTP status). The implementer cannot execute the attempt deterministically; name the configured source or specify that absence of a configured URL itself triggers the uniform fallback with a logged reason.

'aggregate the bootstrap distribution of statistics into a final p-value' names no aggregation method (e.g., fraction of bootstrap statistics exceeding the point estimate, mean p-value, or a cited reference procedure). Without a named method and a deterministic seed, the verification 'reproduces identical statistics' is not executable as specified.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005, T009 vs plan.md:Project Structure and data-model.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: Output paths conflict with the plan/data model: T005 writes data/results/selection_weights.csv (plan: data/processed/selection_weights.csv) and T009 writes figures/ (plan: outputs/figures/). T010 and T011 then reference these paths; an implementer following the plan produces files the tasks' verifications won't find. Align one canonical path set.

The Phase-1 thin pass runs KS on single-point medians, which FR-014 forbids; the checkpoint presents these as 'checkable numerical outputs' without labeling them provisional scaffolding superseded by T006. Add an explicit note that thin-pass p-values are provisional and are overwritten by T006, so the implementer does not treat the checkpoint output as a final FR-014-conformant result.

'analytical KS-power formula preferred; simulation-based fallback only if CPU-cheap' leaves the choice to implementer judgment with no decision criterion; name the analytical formula (or a citation) and drop the vague fallback condition.
